text: OVERDOSAGE Acute overdosage of iron may cause abdominal pain, nausea and vomiting and, in severe cases, cardiovascular collapse and death. Other more chronic symptoms include pallor and cyanosis, melena, shock, drowsiness and coma. The estimated overdose of orally ingested iron is 300 mg/kg body weight. Toxic effects are seen at 10-20 mg/kg elemental iron. When overdoses are ingested by children, severe reactions, including fatalities, have resulted. Folivane™-OB should be stored beyond the reach of children to prevent against accidental iron poisoning. Treatment: For specific therapy, exchange transfusion and chelating agents should be used. For general management, perform gastric lavage with sodium bicarbonate solution or milk. Administer intravenous fluids and electrolytes and use oxygen.
